Odisha CM Questions BJP on Andhra Pradesh Election Notice in Disputed Villages

Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik has questioned the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) silence regarding an election notice issued by Andhra Pradesh in the Kotia villages, which are subject to a long-standing dispute between the two states. Patnaik raised this issue, drawing attention to the former chief minister's involvement in the Odisha-Andhra dispute over the Kotia region.
